# Library

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warnings: false

library(agridat)
library(emmeans)
library(lme4)
library(tidyverse)
```

# Our phenotypic data

## Acyrthosiphon pisum

```{r}
apisum <- read.csv("../../../01.data/2023_screen_specifics_251genotypes/01.acyrthosiphon_pisum_P123amp_on_faba_collection/apisum_fecundity_on_faba_n_higher_than_6_no_zeros.csv") %>% 
  select(genotype, replicate, session, larvae_total_number)
head(apisum)
```

```{r}
# Overlay density and histogram of larvae
ggplot(apisum, aes(x = larvae_total_number)) +
  geom_histogram(aes(y = ..density..), binwidth = 1, fill = "lightblue", color = "black") +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +
  labs(title = "Distribution of the number of A. pisum larvae",
       x = "Number of larvae",
       y = "Density")
```

## Example data

Taken from [Schmidt 2019 companion GitHub repository](https://github.com/PaulSchmidtGit/Heritability/blob/master/Alternative%20Heritability%20Measures/lme4/H2%20Reg%20%26%20H2%20SumDiv.R) 

```{r}
# get example data --------------------------------------------------------
dat <- agridat::john.alpha %>% 
  mutate(Mu = 1) # Create dummy column for pseudo intercept in order to obtain estimate for Mu


# fit model ---------------------------------------------------------------
# random genotype effect
g_ran <- lmer(data    = dat,
              formula = yield ~ 0 + Mu + rep + (1|gen) + (1|rep:block)) # Default intercept set to 0, pseudo intercept Mu instead

# fixed genotype effect
g_fix <- lmer(data    = dat,
              formula = yield ~ rep + gen + (1|rep:block))

```


```{r}
# Compare models ----------------------------------------------------------
anova(g_ran, g_fix)
```

```{r}
# handle model estimates --------------------------------------------------
# genotypic BLUPs
g_BLUPs <- g_ran %>% 
  ranef %>% as_tibble %>% 
  rename(BLUP=condval) %>%
  filter(grpvar=="gen") %>%
  mutate(gen = grp %>% as.character %>% as.factor) %>% 
  select(gen, BLUP)

# estimated marginal means (a.k.a. adjusted means) based on genotypic BLUEs
g_EMMs <- g_fix %>% 
  emmeans("gen") %>% 
  as_tibble %>% 
  select(gen, emmean)

# Overall mean in g_ran
Mu_ran <- g_ran %>% emmeans("Mu") %>% as_tibble %>% pull(emmean)

# Combine BLUPs and emmeans, compute scaled emmeans
Gpreds <- left_join(g_EMMs, g_BLUPs, by="gen") %>% 
  mutate(scaled_emmean = emmean - Mu_ran)


# H2 BLUP~BLUE ------------------------------------------------------------
H2reg <- lm(data    = Gpreds,
            formula = BLUP ~ 0 + scaled_emmean) %>% pluck("coefficients")
H2reg #0.8178116

# H2 sumdiv ---------------------------------------------------------------
H2sumdiv <- sum(abs(Gpreds$BLUP)) / sum(abs(Gpreds$scaled_emmean))
H2sumdiv #0.8205183
```
